lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
viewer-init: 14,337 B beyond the first copy, focus-trap 13,722 B, @nextcloud/vue 389 B, @nextcloud/initial-state 205 B.
viewer-main: 8 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 8 B.
All 2 pages load the same 2 files: 822,335 B raw, 239,617 B gzip, 93.4 % of the smallest page (viewer-main, 880,050 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/dialogs 261,065 B, webdav 105,526 B, vue 75,352 B, @nextcloud/vue 56,679 B, @vue/runtime-core 46,558 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,532 B on the viewer-init page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
1,707 B in 13 pieces of 3 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (89 packages, 969 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
